en.html:
After arranging first aid and transport to hospital for the wounded, handing the attackers over to the police, and attending to the other necessities, we returned to Horigoe.

The late-autumn sun had already set.
The three of us <ruby>passed through<rt>passed through</rt></ruby> the darkening gate without a word.

ja.html:
負傷者の応急処置と病院への搬送、犯行集団の警察
機関への引き渡しなどの手配を終えて堀越へ戻ると、
晩秋の陽は既に落ちていた。
　薄暗い門を三人、会話もなく<ruby>潜<rt>くぐ</rt></ruby>る。
